title: Member Rush Co-Pay Schedule for Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
The member rush co-pay is the part of a Marlowe & Finch Alterations rush fee that a Finch Circle Loyalty Program member keeps paying when a rush fee is waived except for the co-pay. It is set by the member's tier and, for Gold members, by the purchase record the ticket names in Merchandise Purchases.

| Customer | Member rush co-pay |
|---|---|
| Active Finch Circle Platinum member (tier qualifying spend threshold 2500.00 USD, below 5000.00 USD) | 30.00 USD |
| Active Finch Circle Gold member (tier qualifying spend threshold 1200.00 USD, below 2500.00 USD) whose ticket names the member's own purchase record at regular price | 40.00 USD |
| Any other active Finch Circle Gold member | 45.00 USD |
| Anyone else | the whole rush fee standing, so that nothing is waived |

**Records read.** The tier and status of the customer's Finch Circle membership, and the price type (regular, sale, clearance, doorbuster or final sale) of the Merchandise Purchases record named on the ticket.

## Gold members, both sides of the price-type condition

| Gold member's ticket names | Co-pay |
|---|---|
| own purchase record, price type regular | 40.00 USD |
| own purchase record, price type sale | 45.00 USD |
| own purchase record, price type clearance | 45.00 USD |
| no purchase record | 45.00 USD |

For a Platinum member the price type makes no difference: the co-pay is 30.00 USD.

## Hypothetical illustration

On a rush fee of 50.00 USD: a Platinum member's co-pay is 30.00 USD, a Gold member with a regular-price purchase named pays a co-pay of 40.00 USD, and a customer outside Gold and Platinum has a co-pay equal to the whole 50.00 USD.
